title: Hugging Face CLI / Hub — What it is
description: The Hugging Face Hub is the central library of open machine learning: hundreds of thousands of models, datasets and Spaces, each a Git repository with version history. The huggingface_hub Python library and hf / huggingface-cli command move weights between the Hub and your workstation: login once, then download, upload and snapshot any repo. It is how an AI PC gets its brains. It is made by Hugging Face, Inc. and runs on Windows, macOS, Linux (Python).
